scenario: When Raj moved out he had withheld two months of rent. During those exact two months the city had declared the unit legally uninhabitable due to a sewage backup, and Raj had withheld rent through the lawful procedure. The landlord seeks to apply Raj's deposit to the two months of withheld rent.
policy: A landlord may keep a tenant's security deposit to cover unpaid rent, except where the unpaid rent accrued during a period in which the unit was legally uninhabitable and the tenant had lawfully withheld rent. In that case the landlord may not apply the deposit to the withheld rent.
question: May the landlord apply the deposit to the two months of withheld rent?
